newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut Stock Exchange authorises 13th broker.
newsitem.headline: Beirut Stock Exchange authorises 13th broker.

text.p: The Beirut Stock Exchange authorised on Friday Financial Funds Advisors International to operate as an intermediary as of next week, bringing to 13 the number of brokerages on the market.

"The Beirut Stock Exchange Committee announces the approval of the application of Financial Funds Advisors International for dealing in the Beirut bourse hall as of Wednesday, February 26, 1997," the stock exchange said in a circular.

The 12 brokerages currently operating on the market are: Fidus SAL, Banque Mediterranee, Indosuez, Infibank, Banque Saradar, BALOM, Arab Finance Corp, Capital Investment Services, Credit Commerciale et Foncier, Credit Libanais, Lebanon Invest and Middle East Capital Group.
